entities.summary: Oceanário de Lisboa is a aquarium destination in Lisbon, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A landmark central-ocean aquarium whose spatial design and ecosystem presentation remain destination-worthy. This entry is intended for 5–adult travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.

entities.summary: World of Discoveries is a interactive history destination in Porto, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A compact but distinctive ride-and-walkthrough interpretation of Portuguese exploration, stronger as family storytelling than as a conventional museum. This entry is intended for 6–12 travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
